purpose: Test whether the frozen metadata-consistent CF4-disjoint 2M++ count sample can close the velocity-only lowest-bin information deficit at N32 before any z=0 field inference.

authorization.authorization_basis: The user approved the N32 joint velocity-plus-density information-budget pilot after the exact 319-row exclusion and 36,635-row retained-subset gate passed on 2026-09-01.

design.volume_quadrature: tensor-product two-point Gauss-Legendre; eight equal-weight subpoints per N32 voxel
design.bright_apparent_population: Ksmag <= 11.5 with no artificial Ksmag=9 lower cut because the frozen retained sample has no such cut

Schechter.K_evolution_extinction_correction: none added; Ksmag is the published corrected K2M++ magnitude

design.expected_count_normalization: For each population p, lambda_p(x)=N_p*S_p(x)/sum_x S_p(x); only the six observed totals, not galaxy positions, set the Poisson shot-noise scale.
design.reference_bias_semantics: A frozen monotone luminosity-dependent sensitivity vector, not a calibrated 2M++ bias measurement or prior; it is used only in the known-reference-bias technical ceiling.
design.velocity_covariance_surrogate: For each frozen N32 merged bin, use an isotropic diagonal Fourier precision whose posterior/prior trace equals the completed 64-geometry marginalized_s1 mean trace. Use the weaker delta/theta trace and set theta-unavailable bins to prior precision.
design.density_linearization: Gaussianized Poisson Fisher at homogeneous delta=0 with log-normalization nuisance templates; full nonlinear count likelihood is not evaluated.

known_selection_reference_bias_ceiling.semantics: Official angular maps, Schechter radial selection, six reference biases, and all six mean count normalizations treated as known. This is a technical reference ceiling, not a physical absolute upper bound.

normalization_marginalized_reference_bia.semantics: Analytically Schur-marginalize six independent population log-normalizations with flat priors while retaining the frozen reference bias vector.

normalization_marginalized_half_Fisher_s.semantics: Retain one half of the normalization-marginalized density Fisher information as an explicit sensitivity bracket; not a calibrated RSD or bias marginalization.

normalization_marginalized_quarter_Fishe.semantics: Retain one quarter of the normalization-marginalized density Fisher information as an explicit sensitivity bracket; not a calibrated RSD, FoG, selection, or discrepancy marginalization.

design.trace_probe_randomness: 32 deterministic Hermitian Rademacher probes use seeds trace_probe_seed+i; numerical covariance probes only, no truth or data random stream

information_gates.frontier_rule: contiguous joint delta-theta prefix from the lowest N32 bin; theta-unavailable bins fail closed

decision_rule.promotion_rule: No technical-pilot outcome promotes the parent posterior. Exact nuisance calibration on development mocks and later independent validation require a new approved stage.

limitations: The completed velocity artifact supplies bin-average trace fractions, not its full posterior covariance; the velocity term is therefore an isotropic diagonal surrogate.
The population totals estimate shot-noise normalization, but galaxy positions are not consumed as field-likelihood data.
Bias uncertainty is not identifiable in a datum-free homogeneous linearization and is not called marginalized.
RSD, FoG, angular-selection calibration uncertainty, and forward-model discrepancy require mocks or a datum-dependent likelihood and are not called marginalized.
N32 has 12 cMpc/h cells; no 0.3 cMpc/h observational or numerical resolution claim is allowed.
